release_identity: containing Git commit or release tag
geometry_source: preserved native FDR09-R1 stowed four-payload assemblies
camera_scale_policy: Seven preserved four-payload concepts are shown with the same orthographic direction, role colours and 2.013 m × 1.510 m field. Each model is centered on its projected geometry; every scale bar is 500 mm in the image plane. All native parts are retained in those full source views. Expand a drive detail to inspect the actual represented mechanism in its original position; its individual scale is printed. Blue solids are payload proxies and pale blocks are unselected actuator/sensor envelopes.
current_configuration_boundary: FM08-R3 is the selected detailed feeder architecture; ACR1 is the separate integrated twelve-3U configuration. All seven displayed source models remain historical FDR09-R1.
license: CC BY 4.0 project-created source/geometry/exports; installed font dependency is not bundled.

concepts.title: Guided lead screw
concepts.principle: A guided screw and nut drive a reversible lateral pusher.
concepts.rationale: Selected for controllability and available corrected geometry/sizing evidence; the detailed selected study is FM08-R3.

concepts.title: Rack and pawl
concepts.principle: A toothed drive advances the pusher; a pawl provides retention/indexing.
concepts.rationale: Positive engagement is the runner-up. Tooth/root support, backlash and skipped engagement remain engineering costs.

concepts.title: Spring and two gates
concepts.principle: Stored spring energy feeds the payload through a two-gate sequence.
concepts.rationale: Low powered-feed demand; the historical 15 N end-force assumption needs spring/governor redesign for the declared feed demand.
